verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Deadly Dance as a Strike Super Attack.

records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference documents a multi-kick Strike attack with a final launching kick and Ki-Blast-repelling behavior. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.

records.pvp_notes: Fast multi-kick Strike Super with a launching final hit; detailed matchup and frame behavior remains version-sensitive.
